annotations.title: Search the Council's Schedule C awards

description: Search the adopted budget's Schedule C (the Council's discretionary awards as printed in the budget PDF: the body and appendices A, B and C), FY2018–FY2027, from the checked tables BetaNYC reads from the PDFs. Every row is labeled "checked, review in progress" or "checked and reviewed", with its flags, review decision and note where decided, three links (the row highlighted on its page in the explorer, the PDF on GitHub at the build's commit, the publisher's copy where known), and disclosure_status: whether the same EIN and amount is in the Council's disclosure spreadsheet (search_disclosure_awards, a separate tool and a later snapshot) as cleared or pending, or unmatched with the reason. Values are as printed. Sub-awards printed under an award (the Jobs to Build On partner list, FY2018 and FY2019) are listed under it and never counted. Filter by any combination of fiscal_year, organization, ein, member (member, sponsor or delegation, as printed) or council_member_id (exact Legistar person ID, resolved per year from the printed member: 'Levin' and 'Levine' are different people), category, initiative, agency, purpose, disclosure_status, min_amount, max_amount; the answer gives the TRUE match count and totals over every match, highest amount first. Needs the optional PDF tables download; without it the answer says how to add it. Text filters ignore case and accents; a term of 3 or fewer letters and digits matches whole words only ('AI' finds 'AI-powered', not 'AIDS'), a longer one matches anywhere; whole_word true or false overrides that.

council_member_id.description: Exact Legistar person ID of a council member (digits only, e.g. '7567' Stephen T. Levin, '7634' Mark Levine), matched on the row's printed member column (not sponsor or delegation) as resolved for its fiscal year by the repo's member crosswalk (data/pdf_council_member_crosswalk.csv, #72's rules, from the Council MCP's Legistar index). One person's rows are found under every label they were printed with ('Sanchez' to FY2026, 'P. Sanchez' in FY2027). Rows whose printed name is ambiguous (two members of that name served that year, e.g. FY2022 'Barron', FY2026 'Sanchez'), unresolved, a delegation, 'Speaker' or blank carry no ID and never match; the answer says which of them could be the person.

disclosure_status.description: cleared or pending: paired with a row of that status in the disclosure spreadsheet by EIN and amount; unmatched: not found there

ein.description: EIN, exactly 9 digits, hyphens optional. Matches the organization's EIN or its fiscal conduit's (the group that receives the money for it), as the explorer does

fiscal_year.description: FY2018–FY2027. Earlier years were read only by the old parser and are not served.

limit.description: Max rows shown, 1–500 (default 50; above 500 is capped at 500, below 1 is an error). Totals always cover every match.

member.description: Council member, sponsor or delegation as printed (substring), e.g. 'Brewer', 'Speaker', 'Queens Delegation'. A surname is not a person ('Levin' also matches 'Levine'; 'Williams' is two people in different years): the answer lists every printed name and person it matched. For one person, use council_member_id.

organization.description: Organization as printed (case- and accent-insensitive substring; % and _ literal)

whole_word.description: Sets how name and prose filters match: true, whole words only ('AI' not in 'Jamaica', 'Fellow' not in 'Fellowship'); false, anywhere ('AI' in 'AIDS'). Omit for the default: a term of 3 or fewer letters and digits matches whole words, a longer one anywhere.
